newsitem.title: FRANCE: Wages strike to disrupt French trains on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Wages strike to disrupt French trains on Thursday.

text.p: A 24-hour strike by train conductors will cut French passenger rail traffic by up to two-thirds on Thursday, the state railway company SNCF said.
SNCF said conductors in different parts of the country would stage 24-hour walkouts at various times between 8 p.m. on Wednesday and 8 a.m. on Friday.
Eurostar trains between Paris and London will run normally, but other high-speed trains will be cut by one-third to two-thirds.
The company said one regional train in three would run, and commuter traffic in the Paris region would be slightly disrupted.
Six trade unions called the strike over wages and working conditions. France is preparing for early parliamentary elections on May 25 and June 1, called on Monday by President Jacques Chirac.
